renderings.value: She presumes him to be innocent.
She got it into her head that I was bad-mouthing her.
He took it for granted that she was happy.
He put the idea into my head.
I was given to understand that she was ill.
Today cars are so popular that we assume everyone has one.
"What happened to your nose?" "When I was backing my car up I went to check behind me, convinced that the car window was open, and bashed my face into it!"
He supposed that you would book seats.
What? Alex was a woman? This whole time I thought she was a man.
Tom was worried that Mary's words were indirectly aimed at him, but in truth she was only talking about herself in a self-depreciating manner.

The monkey, who came from the mountain to play in the village, picked up a red candle. There aren't many red candles. So the monkey thought of it as a firework. He brought it back to the mountain with care.
Mary is convinced that Tom likes her.
